user.title: Add timer
user.description: Choose the Bluetooth address that matches the MAC# on the barcode sticker of your device.

device_generation.title: Timer generation
device_generation.description: Select the generation of the physical timer you are adding. 1st Gen devices are light grey in color, and 2nd Gen devices are darker grey with 'GEN 2' printed above the button.

network_key.title: Gen 2 credentials
network_key.description: If the timer already has the integration's network key, uncheck pairing and enter the key below. To pair a fresh timer, leave pairing enabled and leave the key empty to generate one.

data.gen2_run_pairing: Pair timer (press button 5x until LED blinks red)

gen1_mesh.title: Gen 1 credentials
gen1_mesh.description: If the timer already has credentials, uncheck pairing below and enter them. To pair a fresh or factory-reset timer, leave pairing enabled and leave the fields empty to generate new credentials.

data.gen1_run_pairing: Pair timer (press button 5x until LED blinks red)

error.invalid_key: Invalid key. Enter a valid 32 character hex string and try again.
error.invalid_device_id: Enter the device ID as a decimal number (0–65535).
error.credentials_required: Enter both device ID and network key when pairing is disabled.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect or provision the timer. Put it in pairing mode and try again.
error.verify_failed: Handshake worked but the timer did not return device information. Try again.

init.title: Orbit B-hyve
init.description: Add a timer or change Bluetooth status polling.

poll_interval.title: Status polling interval
poll_interval.description: How often Home Assistant reads battery and station status from each timer over Bluetooth. Longer intervals reduce battery use. Turning a station on or off still triggers an immediate update.
